summary: Village Super Market filed a routine Form 8-K on September 11, 2026, announcing that its Board of Directors declared quarterly cash dividends of $0.25 per Class A share and $0.1625 per Class B share, payable October 22, 2026 to holders of record at the close of business on October 1, 2026. CFO John L. Van Orden signed the report. The company operates 34 supermarkets under ShopRite and Fairway banners and three Gourmet Garage specialty markets. This is an ordinary capital-return declaration, not a special situation; no strategic, transactional or structural terms are present. Risk-arb angle: none.
